density: finite odd Hermite combinations are Schwartz-dense in odd Schwartz space

acceptance_test: Prove or refute that positivity of the even Weil distribution on all odd Schwartz convolution squares detects every off-critical zero; explicitly analyze the parity decomposition and interpolation at the complex zero loci.
